data.long_meaning: The Old English name Barger originated from the word ‘beorc,’ which means ‘barley.’ The name was commonly given to farmers who worked with barley, which was a significant crop in the Anglo-Saxon society. The name Barger carries the meaning “Barley farmer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Barger usually hope their child will grow to embody barley farmer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
